read.thesis: Q4 book-to-bill 1.6x and FY backlog $118B (+30%) with capex up 27% to $1.2B and more planned; supply expansion is visible, but no pricing or utilisation data disclosed.

capex.quote: investing nearly $1.2 billion in capital expenditures in 2025 – with even more investments planned in the year ahead.

triggers.label: Capex up 27% to $1.2B
triggers.quote: $1.2 billion in capital expenditures for the year, up 27% from 2024

triggers.label: Book-to-bill 1.6x in Q4
triggers.quote: Book-to-bill of 1.6x in the quarter and 1.5x for the full year, ending the year with $118 billion in backlog

red_flags.label: Q4 Marine operating margin down to 7.2% from 5.1% comparison; Aerospace Q4 margin 12.7% vs 15.6%
